summary: MBX Biosciences filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing one-year Phase 2 data for canvuparatide. The press release detailed sustained efficacy in chronic hypoparathyroidism. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine clinical trial data update, not a special situation.
